place.title: IM|Sciences Main Academic Block
place.desc: Modern university campus with a grand central entrance staircase leading to lecture halls.

person.name: Areeba
person.bio: Areeba is a high-achieving 3rd-year student who manages student debate forums and values independent, dignified movement across campus.

situation.title: 8 Minutes to Semester Exam
situation.desc: Areeba has 8 minutes to travel from the entrance lobby to Examination Hall C on the elevated 1st tier. The central staircase is the primary path used by walking students.

barrier.title: Staircase Default on Campus Wayfinding
barrier.desc: The digital campus wayfinding kiosks and app only calculate distance, directing all students up 18 concrete steps. No step-free route, ramp slope, or elevator status is visible.

options.title: Profile Badge Fix
options.desc: Add a static wheelchair icon beside Areeba's name in the student database and tell her to ask security guards for manual assistance at the entrance.
options.critique: This creates dependency and undermines student dignity. Physical access must support unassisted, independent autonomy rather than forcing people to repeatedly ask for personal favors.

options.title: Multi-Path Accessible Wayfinding
options.desc: Encode step-free topology in the campus wayfinding system: show the continuous smooth ramp corridor via West Wing, elevator availability, door clearance, and precise travel time (6 mins).
options.critique: Outstanding! This treats accessibility as a foundational property of spatial navigation. Areeba can plan her trip independently with predictable timing.

options.title: Emergency Phone Hotline
options.desc: Place a printed phone number at the base of the stairs for wheelchair users to call the administration building to request a portable ramp.
options.critique: A reactive phone hotline causes unacceptable delays, requires network connectivity, and fails when staff are occupied during class changeovers.

consequence.beforeText: Areeba arrives at the base of 18 steep concrete steps with only 8 minutes remaining. She must wait awkwardly hoping another student or guard can carry her wheelchair.
consequence.afterText: The campus app immediately routes Areeba via the West Ramp and Academic Lift 2. Visual wayfinding markers illuminate the step-free path. She rolls into Exam Hall C with 2 minutes to spare, completely unassisted.

principle.title: Equivalent Access & Independent Mobility
principle.description: Services and spaces should enable every individual to participate independently with dignity. Accessibility fails when it forces people into submissive, delayed, or reliant protocols to access standard services.
principle.digitalConnection: Digital mapping tools must not assume uniform human locomotion. Wayfinding datasets must model incline grades, elevator operational telemetry, threshold heights, and surface textures.

portfolioAnalysis.designConstraint: Physical architectural barriers cannot always be demolished instantly, requiring digital coordination of existing accessible assets.
portfolioAnalysis.serviceTouchpoint: Physical Campus Pathways ↔ Real-Time Kiosk / Mobile Navigation Layer

place.title: Rahim's Fresh Fruit Cart (Thela)
place.desc: Bustling roadside stall with stacked crates of Swat oranges and seasonal strawberries on Board Bazar.

person.name: Rahim
person.assistiveTech: Basic Android phone, hands-free audio preference
person.contextType: Situational impairment (busy hands, bright glare, street noise)
person.bio: Rahim is an experienced entrepreneur who takes pride in the quality of his fruit. He handles cash with ease and adopted digital payments to serve university students.

situation.title: Rush Hour Digital Payment Confirmation
situation.desc: A customer scans Rahim's printed QR code to pay Rs 1,450 for a crate of oranges while Rahim's hands are sticky weighing apples for another customer.

barrier.title: Ephemeral Green Checkmark
barrier.desc: The current payment app flashes a tiny green checkmark icon for 1.2 seconds, plays no sound, and immediately reverts to the empty QR scan screen. Rahim cannot verify the amount or whether the transaction succeeded.

options.title: Make the Green Checkmark Larger
options.desc: Scale the green checkmark icon up by 50% on the screen, keeping the duration at 1.5 seconds.
options.critique: This relies entirely on the visual channel and color perception. If Rahim is looking away or his screen is tilted away in sunlight, he still has zero confirmation.

options.title: Persistent State + Spoken Audio + Distinct Haptic
options.desc: Keep a persistent confirmation receipt card on screen showing exact amount ('Rs 1,450 — Received') until dismissed, accompanied by a loud dual-tone audio chime and Pashto/Urdu voice announcement ('Chaudah sau pachaas rupay mosool huay') with a double haptic pulse.
options.critique: Exemplary multimodal HCI design! Rahim doesn't even need to wash his hands or look at his phone; the redundant audio, haptic, and persistent visual card give him 100% confidence.

options.title: Send an SMS 10 Minutes Later
options.desc: Send an end-of-hour SMS summary listing batch transactions.
options.critique: A fruit vendor cannot let a customer walk away with merchandise without real-time settlement verification. Delayed summaries cause financial anxiety.

consequence.beforeText: Rahim wipes his sticky hands on his apron to squint at his sun-bleached phone screen. The screen is already back to the blank home screen. He has to awkwardly ask the customer to show their phone screen.
consequence.afterText: While weighing fruit, Rahim's phone emits a crisp melodic chime followed by a clear audio announcement: 'Received: Rs 1,450'. His phone screen stays on a bold receipt card with big text. Rahim smiles: 'Shukriya brother, have a great day!'

principle.title: Redundant Multimodal Feedback & Situational Impairment
principle.description: Situational factors (bright sunlight, greasy/wet hands, competing tasks, ambient noise) create functional limitations identical to sensory disabilities. Critical transaction status must NEVER depend on a single sensory mode (vision alone or color alone).
principle.digitalConnection: Use Web Audio API / native media speakers, Web Vibration API, and persistent ARIA live regions with role='status' and aria-atomic='true'.
principle.wcag: WCAG 2.2 — 1.4.1 Use of Color, 4.1.3 Status Messages

portfolioAnalysis.designConstraint: Physical outdoor trade environment with direct 40°C sunlight glare, high ambient traffic noise, and manual multitasking.
portfolioAnalysis.serviceTouchpoint: QR Payment Gateway ↔ Smartphone Speaker / Vibration Motor ↔ Merchant Trust

place.title: Hashtnagri Local Bus Terminal
place.desc: Decorated Bedford truck-art buses lined up with hand-painted filigree, roaring diesel engines, and bustling crowds.

person.name: Gul Khan
person.contextType: Non-literate in written scripts + mild red-green color deficiency
person.bio: Gul Khan works in construction and travels across Peshawar daily. He is intelligent and street-smart but never had formal schooling to read Urdu or English text.

situation.title: Identifying the Correct Bus to Karkhano Market
situation.desc: Three identical decorated buses are parked side by side at dusk under dim streetlights. Gul Khan needs to board the bus to Karkhano, not the one to Charsadda.

barrier.title: Handwritten Cursive Script & Color-Only Route Bands
barrier.desc: Bus operators currently distinguish routes using handwritten Urdu calligraphy on wooden placards ('کارخانو مارکیٹ') and subtle green vs red ribbons tied to side mirrors. In the dark, the cursive script is unreadable to Gul Khan, and he cannot distinguish the faded red ribbon from green.

options.title: Tell Gul Khan to Ask Other Passengers Every Time
options.desc: Rely on informal verbal inquiry where Gul Khan must shout into each bus window asking the conductor.
options.critique: Creates constant social friction and embarrassment. In noisy terminals, conductors give contradictory or hasty answers.

options.title: Redundant Multi-Coded Route Identity (Number + Shape + Color + Audio)
options.desc: Implement redundant route encoding: assign bold numeric route codes ('Bus 7'), a distinct geometric shape badge (e.g., Yellow Star for Karkhano, Blue Diamond for Charsadda), high-contrast reflective lettering, and an external speaker chime that announces destination when boarding doors open.
options.critique: A classic HCI tenet: Redundant Encoding! Never communicate critical information through color or text alone. Combining numbers, distinct geometric symbols, high-contrast typography, and audio ensures 100% universal comprehension.

options.title: Install GPS Trackers on Buses with a Mobile App
options.desc: Launch an iOS and Android tracking app showing bus GPS coordinates on a Google Map.
options.critique: Completely useless to Gul Khan, who uses a basic keypad phone and cannot read digital maps. High-tech solutions that ignore user context fail.

consequence.beforeText: Gul Khan wanders between noisy idling diesel buses, trying to read smudged handwritten signs. He boards the wrong bus and ends up 12 km off course in Charsadda.
consequence.afterText: From 30 meters away, Gul Khan immediately spots the bold Yellow Star badge and Route Number 7 on the windshield. As he approaches, a clear loudspeaker announces: 'Bus 7 — Karkhano Direct.' He boards confidently without needing to ask anyone.

principle.title: Redundant Multi-Channel Encoding
principle.description: Never rely on a single visual variable (especially color alone or written text alone) to convey critical operational status. Pair text with numbers, distinct geometric silhouettes, high-contrast icons, and auditory announcements.
principle.digitalConnection: Dual encoding standards in UI design: icons must accompany color-coded alerts, and visual badges must have screen-reader and audio equivalents.
principle.wcag: WCAG 2.2 — 1.4.1 Use of Color, 1.1.1 Non-text Content

portfolioAnalysis.designConstraint: Low formal literacy, color vision deficiency (protanopia/deuteranopia), and dim evening terminal lighting.
portfolioAnalysis.serviceTouchpoint: Bus Frontage Signage ↔ Passenger Mental Model ↔ Boarding Audio Announcer

ur.placeTitle: ہشت نگری لوکل بس اڈہ، پشاور
ur.placeDesc: رنگ برنگے ٹرک آرٹ سے سجی روایتی بیڈفورڈ بسیں، ڈیزل کے دھویں اور ہارنوں میں گھرا پشاور کا تاریخی اڈہ۔
ur.personBio: گل خان روزانہ مزدوری کے لیے پشاور بھر کا سفر کرتے ہیں۔ وہ تجربہ کار ہیں لیکن اسکول نہ جانے کی وجہ سے پڑھ نہیں سکتے۔
ur.personContext: تحریری اردو سے ناواقفیت + سرخ و سبز رنگ میں ہلکا فرق نہ کر پانا
ur.situationTitle: کارخانو مارکیٹ جانے والی بس کی پہچان
ur.situationDesc: شام کے دھندلکے میں تین ایک جیسی سجی ہوئی بسیں کھڑی ہیں۔ گل خان کو کارخانو والی بس میں بیٹھنا ہے، چارسدہ والی میں نہیں۔
ur.barrierTitle: لکڑی کے تختے پر ہاتھ کی باریک خطاطی اور صرف ربن
ur.barrierDesc: ڈرائیوروں نے لکڑی کی تختی پر پیچیدہ خطاطی میں نام لکھا ہے اور شیشے پر سرخ اور سبز فیتے باندھے ہیں جو شام میں گل خان کو سمجھ نہیں آتے۔

A.title: ہر بار کنڈکٹر سے چلا کر پوچھنا
A.desc: گل خان سے کہیں کہ وہ ہر بس کی کھڑکی میں سر ڈال کر اندر بیٹھے کنڈکٹر سے چیخ کر پوچھیں۔
A.critique: شور میں کنڈکٹر اکثر غلط یا جلدی میں جواب دیتے ہیں، اور ہر بار پوچھنا محنت کش کے لیے کوفت اور ہچکچاہٹ کا باعث بنتا ہے۔

B.title: کثیر الجہتی پہچان: جلی نمبر + ہندسی نشان + بیرونی اسپیکر
B.desc: ہر روٹ کو واضح بڑا نمبر (بس 7)، نمایاں ہندسی نشان (کارخانو کے لیے پیلا ستارہ)، اور دروازہ کھلتے ہی اسپیکر سے اعلان: 'بس 7 برائے کارخانو'۔
B.critique: ہیومن کمپیوٹر انٹرایکشن کا بنیادی اصول: Redundant Encoding! کبھی بھی صرف رنگ یا صرف تحریر پر انحصار نہ کریں۔ علامت، نمبر اور آواز کا ملاپ سب کے لیے آسان ہے۔

C.title: موبائل میں گوگل میپ ایپ انسٹال کرنا
C.desc: بسوں میں جی پی ایس لگا کر اسمارٹ فون ایپ پر نقشہ دکھایا جائے۔
C.critique: گل خان کے پاس بٹنوں والا چھوٹا فون ہے اور وہ نقشہ نہیں پڑھ سکتے۔ صارف کے حالات سمجھے بغیر ٹیکنالوجی تھوپنا ناکام رہتا ہے۔

ur.beforeText: گل خان دھواں چھوڑتی بسوں کے درمیان گھبرا کر کھڑے رہتے ہیں، تختی نہ پڑھ سکنے کی وجہ سے غلط بس میں چڑھ جاتے ہیں اور چارسدہ پہنچ جاتے ہیں۔
ur.afterText: دور سے ہی گل خان کو بس کے ماتھے پر چمکتا پیلا ستارہ اور بڑا ہندسہ 7 نظر آ جاتا ہے۔ دروازے کے اسپیکر سے آواز آتی ہے: 'بس 7، کارخانو'۔ وہ پورے اطمینان سے سوار ہوتے ہیں۔
ur.principleTitle: کثیر الجہتی علامتی ترسیل (Redundant Multi-Coded Encoding)
ur.principleDesc: کسی اہم چیز کی پہچان کے لیے کبھی صرف رنگ یا صرف لکھائی پر انحصار نہ کریں۔ نمبر، ہندسی اشکال، ہائی کنٹراسٹ اور آواز کا ملاپ ہر انسان کو خود مختار بناتا ہے۔

ps.placeDesc: په ټرک آرټ ښکلې شوې دودیزې بېډفورډ بسونه او د مسافرو ګڼه ګوڼه.
ps.personBio: ګل خان هره ورځ د کار لپاره پېښور ته راځي خو د ښوونځي نه لوستلو له امله لیک نه شي لوستلی.
ps.personContext: بې سوادي + په تیاره کې د رنګونو نه پېژندل
ps.situationDesc: په ماښام کې درې یو شان بسونه ولاړ دي او ګل خان باید کارخانو ته لاړ شي.
ps.barrierTitle: پر لرګي پېچلی لاس لیک او کمزوري پټۍ
ps.barrierDesc: پر بسونو یوازې نازک خط لیکل شوی چې په تیاره کې نه لوستل کیږي.

A.title: له کنډکټر نه پوښتل
A.desc: ګل خان دې له هر چا پوښتنه وکړي.
A.critique: په شور کې سم ځواب نه ورکول کیږي او سړی شرمیږي.

B.title: لوی نمبر + نښه (ژیړ ستوری) + د دروازې لوډسپیکر
B.desc: هر روټ ته یو ځانګړی نمبر او نښه (د کارخانو لپاره ژیړ ستوری) او د دروازې سپیکر کې غږ ورکول.
B.critique: د ډیزاین لوی اصل! شمېره، نښه او غږ ټول انسانان باواکه کوي.

C.title: د ګوګل نقشې اپلیکیشن لګول
C.critique: ګل خان سمارټ فون نه لري او نقشه نه شي لوستلی.

ps.beforeText: ګل خان په غلط بس کې کښیني او چارسدې ته ورسیږي.
ps.afterText: ګل خان له لرې ځلیدونکی ژیړ ستوری او نمبر ۷ ویني او په ډاډه زړه بس ته خېژي.
ps.principleTitle: څو ډوله نښانې او د پوهاوي اسانتیا
ps.principleDesc: هېڅکله معلومات یوازې په لیکلو مه پریږدئ؛ رنګ، بڼه او غږ د ټولو لپاره دي.
